preconditions.description: The number of pillars n is between 1 and 100,000.
The minimum height difference d is between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= hi <= 10**15 for hi in heights)
preconditions.description: Each pillar height hi is between 1 and 1,000,000,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the jump sequence k is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i1 < i2 < ... < ik <= n for i1, i2, ..., ik in jump_sequence)
postconditions.description: The indices in the jump sequence are strictly increasing and within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(abs(heights[i1-1] - heights[i2-1]) >= d for i1, i2 in zip(jump_sequence, jump_sequence[1:]))
postconditions.description: The height difference between consecutive pillars in the jump sequence is at least d.
The length of the jump sequence matches the number of indices printed.
